description: Source file implementing the Association Request Frame parsing and validation logic for Wi-Fi management frames, including methods for initializing, validating, and extracting frame attributes.

classes.name: AssocReqFrame
classes.description: Class representing the Association Request Frame, with methods for parsing, validation, and attribute access.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a buffer into an AssocReqFrame object, initializing and validating the frame based on type.

methods.name: init_assoc_frame
methods.description: Initializes the frame as an association request, parsing mandatory fields.

methods.name: init_reassoc_frame
methods.description: Initializes the frame as a reassociation request, parsing mandatory fields.

methods.name: add_ssid_field
methods.description: Adds the SSID attribute to the frame during parsing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Parses optional attributes in the frame.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the frame, swapping byte order if needed.
